channel.title: Swansea Labour news
channel.description: Stories from Swansea Labour, for the Swansea Labour Councillors Facebook page

item.title: Labour council fills 5,656 potholes this year as £14m roads programme rolls out
item.description: Swansea's Labour council has filled 5,656 potholes since January as part of a £14m programme to improve the city's roads, and is asking residents to have their say in a survey closing on 2 November.

item.title: Labour council invites residents to help shape the future of Gower
item.description: Swansea's Labour council wants residents' views on the draft Gower Partnership Plan, which sets out how Gower's landscape, wildlife and heritage will be protected. The online survey closes at noon on 4 November 2026.

item.title: Labour council's libraries lend out Wintering Well boxes to beat the winter blues
item.description: Swansea's Labour council is offering free Wintering Well Boxes to borrow from seven libraries, each with a daylight lamp, activity ideas and an online course to help residents stay well this winter.

item.title: Labour's Bascule Bridge restoration gathers pace on the River Tawe
item.description: Swansea's Labour council is pressing ahead with the restoration of the 117-year-old Bascule Bridge, which will return next year as a walking and cycling route over the River Tawe.

item.title: Labour council's One Stop Shop brings support to Swansea families
item.description: Swansea's Labour council brought children, young people and families together with support services at a One Stop Shop event at the National Waterfront Museum.

item.title: Labour council packs half-term with free and low-cost family fun
item.description: Swansea's Labour council is giving families a half-term full of free and low-cost things to do, from Spooks in the City and pumpkin trails to science shows, library crafts and sports camps.

item.title: Labour brings Wales' only dockless e-bike scheme to Swansea
item.description: Swansea's Labour council has appointed Voi to run a city-wide e-bike scheme, the only dockless one in Wales, with free first rides and discounts for people on low incomes.

item.title: Labour council helps older residents check if they can claim Pension Credit
item.description: Swansea's Labour council is running a free Pension Credit drop-in at Ty Dewi Sant in Fforestfach on 28 October, where its Financial Inclusion Team will check what older residents can claim.

item.title: Labour's free Christmas buses return for a sixth year
item.description: Swansea's Labour council is bringing back free bus travel for the Christmas Parade weekend and every festive weekend, helping families save on travel and backing city centre businesses.
